page.layout: One page of text in a single column; the running head at the top; the page number at the top left; no margin notes beyond the quotation marks at the left edge, which are printed quotation marks of the text and not notes; a digitiser's watermark at the bottom right is left out.

main_text.p: „Sicut jusserat Nabuchodonosor, ut aurea „statua adoraretur: quod qui facere noluerunt, Deo talia prohibenti placuerunt. Quando autem imperatores veritatem tenent, pro ipsa contra errorem jubent. „Quod quisquis contempserit, ipse sibi judicium acquirit. Nam & inter homines „poenas luit & apud Deum sortem non habebit, quia hoc facere noluit, quod ei per „cor regis ipsa veritas jussit: sicut ipse Nabuchodonosor postea miraculo salutis trium „puerorum commotis, atque mutatus, pro „veritate contra errorem edictum proposuit, „ut quicunque blasphemarent Deum Sidrac, Misac, & Abdenego, in interitum „irent, & domus eorum in dispersionem. „Et non vultis ut aliquid tale contra vos, „jubeant imperatores Christiani, cum sciant „à vobis in iis quos rebaptizatis, Christum „exsufflari. & post. Julianus extitit infidelis imperator. Nonne extitit Apostata, „iniquus, idololatra? Milites Christiani servierunt imperatori infideli. Ubi venieba-„tur ad causam Christi, non agnoscebant „nisi illum, qui in coelo erat. Quando vo-„lebat, ut idola colerent, ut thuificarent, „praeponebant illi Deum. Quando autem „dicebat, producite aciem, ite contra illam „gentem, statim obtemperabant. Distin-„guebant dominum aeternum à domino „temporali: & tamen subditi erant propter „dominum

page.notes: Quotation marks at the left of each line are printed; the marks at the start of lines are treated as the printed quotation mark convention. Some letters are faint or broken in the scan (e.g. "Nabuchodonosor", "dominum" at the line end, "exsufflari"); the line "„dominum" is the last printed line of the page and may be incomplete. Long s rendered as s; the title "SECT. II. CAP. II." is the running head.
